row.evidence: Stoplight's public roadmap still lists "SCIM Support" as an unshipped idea ("Do you want SCIM supported to simplify user (de)provisioning process?"), and its SSO docs cover only SAML and LDAP sign-in on Pro Team and Enterprise.
row.notes: Unchanged from June: no SCIM on any plan; SCIM sits in the Ideas tab of roadmap.stoplight.io. Prices unchanged: Basic $44/mo (3 users included, $11 per additional user), Startup $113/mo (8 users, $11), Pro Team $362/mo (15 users, $22), all billed annually; Enterprise by quote. Base-plus-seat pricing, so per-user fields are null. LDAP & SAML SSO start at Pro Team. Approved email domains (Basic and above) let users auto-join. The only public API is the Catalog export API, with no user management.

scim.notes: SCIM is an open idea on Stoplight's public roadmap, not a shipped feature.

user_api.notes: The public Stoplight API (https://api.stoplight.io) only exports project files; 'User Management / Audit' is an open roadmap idea.

audit_log_api.notes: Activity logs exist in-app on Pro Team, but no API.

okta.notes: Stoplight's guide has admins create their own SAML 2.0 app; okta.com/integrations/stoplight/ returned 404.

entra.notes: Listed as tested for SAML; no Microsoft Learn tutorial found (404).

fallbacks.other_sync: LDAP authentication; approved email domains for automatic workspace join
fallbacks.notes: Bulk invite by pasting comma-separated emails; no CSV import documented.
